# DockPinCollapseNL's first arm reads the pin button by id before its header has focus, and a withdrawn action has no node since the toolbar stopped rendering it

## Problem

Since #18069 (#18042) a focus-gated header action that is withdrawn has no DOM node at all — the toolbar withholds it (`component.Base#domWithheld`) instead of hiding it, so no consumer stylesheet can resurrect it. The component specs were adapted in that PR (an `openActionGate` helper); the e2e sibling was not.

`test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockPinCollapseNL.spec.mjs`, first arm ("the header pin action collapses a pane to its edge rail, and the reveal overlay brings it back"), resolves the inspector's pin action through the worker (`getActionItem('pin')`, worker truth, still valid) and then reads the button's `aria-label` and glyph class by DOM id while the inspector header is still unfocused. The node does not exist yet, so the arm is red on plain `dev`:

```
Error: expect(locator).toHaveAttribute(expected) failed
Locator: locator('#neo-button-17') · element(s) not found
> 172 |         await expect(pinButton).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'unpin');
```

The same arm focuses the inspector at line 197 and asserts the button visible — the two DOM reads belong after that point. The four theme arms of the spec focus first and are green (4/4 on `dev@4e0e9dd8c3`, measured 14:41Z). Measured and reported by @neo-fable-clio at 14:23Z; reproduced from this seat at 14:42Z.

## Evidence

- `DockPinCollapseNL.spec.mjs:164–173` — worker-truth poll, then the DOM reads by id; `:197–199` — `focusPane('inspector')`, `toBeVisible`, click.
- `src/toolbar/Base.mjs#applyContextualActionState` — the inactive branch sets `domWithheld` + `vdom.removeDom`.
- `test/playwright/component/dashboard/DockBootSweep.spec.mjs:56` — the component-side gate helper from #18069.

## Change

Move the accessible-name and glyph assertions to after the inspector header holds focus, next to the existing `toBeVisible`, with a comment stating the contract: the projected instance is worker truth from the first projection; its node exists only while the header's action gate is open. No product change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The first arm of `DockPinCollapseNL.spec.mjs` is green on `dev` (e2e config, Brain runtime root); the whole spec 5/5.
- [ ] The worker-truth assertion (the action instance exists before any focus) stays where it is.
- [ ] Diff is the spec only.

## Non-goals

- The component-side specs (adapted in #18069).
- Running the e2e project in CI (#17853) — this red was invisible to CI for that reason, as the reveal-pin baselines were.

Sub of #13158. Sweep 14:42Z before filing: live latest-20 open (no match), A2A (Clio's measurement, no claim), Knowledge Base (dock leaves only).
